correctness.rationale: For every n≥2 and i≥2, the explicit maximum-to-last-prefix-position map has exactly i preimages per record-conditioned permutation. Every swap is a convex-Monge cost decrease for all nondecreasing convex rank-loss functions, proving the stochastic order in all dimensions. Unordered-prefix uniformity and E[max of i without-replacement numbers]=i(n+1)/(i+1) give the stated footrule and squared-loss exact covariance formulas. The standalone enumerator passed 1,901,150 assertions up to n=8, supporting but not replacing the general proof.

value.rationale: The joint relationship between upper records and rank disarray is a natural finite-sample question. The explicit size-uniform coupling controls all upper tails for every nondecreasing convex separable rank-loss function simultaneously, while the exact footrule and Spearman-squared covariances quantify sitewise influence and aggregate record-count dependence. These are mathematically motivated structural data beyond a routine marginal footrule table or cheap normalization test; no unsupported downstream application is asserted.
